create_Challenge_instance: create a Challenge instance that reads CHALLENGE_CONFIG_FILE from the environment and initializes benchmark evaluation
submit_agent_evaluation: submit an agent to the Challenge for evaluation and log all resulting metrics to the logger
run_remote_challenge_evaluation: run a Challenge with eval_remote set to True to evaluate an agent on the remote evaluation server
review_Challenge_submit: review the Challenge submit method to understand how agent metrics are evaluated and logged
refactor_Challenge_init: refactor the Challenge constructor to accept config paths as a parameter instead of reading from environment variables
